baseline_models.focus_anchor: The present plural verb at word 2 governs the life qualified at word 4 as near, lower, or first.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line combines deliberate preference with a proximity-ranked object, so it describes an active ordering operation rather than passive fondness.

activation_trace.role: Putting something first supplies the deliberate rank-changing operation.
Preferring one thing supplies the ordinary choice relation anchoring the model.
Life as benefit or saving good makes the object an experienced field of value, not bare duration.
The nearer, lower, or first side supplies the criterion by which this life is promoted.

changed_reading.before: You happen to like worldly life more.
changed_reading.after: You actively install the nearer and lower life as the first-ranked benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same word-2 root that expresses preference also carries a branch of reserving something for oneself.
baseline_models.mechanism: Preference can coexist with appropriation: the plural subjects do not only esteem immediate life but treat its accessible benefit as something to secure for themselves.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive possession for oneself turns valuation into a mode of allocation.
Life as benefit supplies what is being appropriated.
Nearness makes that benefit immediately reachable and therefore easy to reserve.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports an inward preference.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also diagnose an outward practice of privatizing the benefit that lies nearest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 belongs to an inventory that includes following a prior trace and becoming skilled through repeated familiarity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ongoing plural choice may be a learned track: familiar near life leaves the clearest route, and repeated following turns proximity into practiced competence.

activation_trace.role: Following a predecessor's trace supplies the path-dependent shape of the preference.
Skill acquired by practice supplies repetition and habituation.
Animate lived existence supplies the concrete track repeatedly navigated.
Nearness explains why this track is encountered and rehearsed first.

changed_reading.before: The preference is a single conscious comparison.
changed_reading.after: The preference can be an acquired groove that repeatedly follows the most familiar nearby signs of life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening superlative height and the focus superlative nearness form opposed poles. Preference now appears as a vertical inversion that puts the lower-nearer pole first.

activation_trace.role: Putting first supplies the act that reverses the rank order.
The nearer, lower, or first side supplies the promoted pole.
Elevation supplies the opposite spatial pole against which worldly nearness is ranked.
The upper direction makes the contrast a directional ordering, not only an abstract value judgment.

structural_cues: The window opens with the superlative al-a'la at 87:1 and the focus closes with al-dunya at 87:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: opposed upper and nearer-lower branch images. Reader arrow: choosing the near pole installs a reversed vertical hierarchy. Live alternative: the contrast may remain temporal rather than spatial.

changed_reading.before: Near life is simply preferred to an unnamed alternative.
changed_reading.after: The lower-nearer pole is actively raised over the highest pole, making the preference an inversion of the window's vertical order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is presented through measuring, balancing, planning, and guiding; the focus subjects replace that calibrated decision system with proximity as their practical metric.

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies the human selection operation being recalibrated.
Nearness supplies the substitute heuristic used by the subjects.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies an objective scale beyond immediate proximity.
Middle, equity, and an impartial place supply balanced evaluation.
Planning by measure and consideration supplies purposive calibration.
Gentle direction toward a way or truth supplies the offered decision path.

structural_cues: 87:2-3 chains created-then-proportioned and measured-then-guided with consecutive fa clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: measure, balance, planning, guidance, and nearness. Reader arrow: the focus preference substitutes what is close for what has been calibrated. Live alternative: the earlier verbs may describe creation without specifying a human decision rule.

changed_reading.before: The subjects desire an immediate object.
changed_reading.after: The subjects use immediacy as a faulty metric, overriding a world already presented as measured and guided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pasture sequence gives worldly life a material time course: living growth is made into dark flood-borne debris. Preference selects the nearby visible phase and mistakes a transient surface or residue for stable life.

activation_trace.role: Earth made alive by rain and growth lets life be read as a vegetative process.
A remaining sign of what was supplies the residue that can be mistaken for the whole process.
Nearness explains why one currently visible phase dominates perception.
Pasture and grazing supply the living productive phase.
Making a thing become a state supplies the transformation arrow between phases.
Scum floating and carried by floodwater supplies the unstable surface endpoint.
Pasture becoming brittle debris explicitly joins living growth to its spent remainder.
Blackness or dark redness supplies the visual terminal state.

structural_cues: 87:4-5 moves from bringing out pasture to making it dark debris through a causal fa sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: growth, transformation, floating debris, darkness, and near life. Reader arrow: the focus subjects freeze the process at its salient nearby phase and prefer that frame. Live alternative: the pasture sequence may only exemplify power and impermanence.

changed_reading.after: Worldly life is a moving material cycle, and the error is selecting its nearest surface phase as though it were the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation and reminder preserve transmissible traces against forgetting, while overt and hidden form unequal visibility channels. The near life wins by availability unless reminder makes the non-near cognitively present.

activation_trace.role: A report transmitted until handed down supplies durable counter-memory.
A remaining sign supplies evidence that persists when its source is absent.
Nearness supplies the availability advantage of immediate life.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation supply the preservation channel.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure mode that would erase distant value.
What appears plainly to the eye supplies the high-salience channel.
Concealment supplies the low-salience channel that preference can neglect.
Bringing something back to mind supplies the corrective operation.

structural_cues: 87:6-10 repeatedly moves through recitation, non-forgetting, overt and hidden knowledge, reminder, and remembering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: preservation, forgetting, visibility, concealment, reminder, and nearness. Reader arrow: visible immediacy receives excess decision weight unless memory carries the absent alternative. Live alternative: these cues may concern revelation without modeling attention.

changed_reading.before: The preference is a stable judgment of value.
changed_reading.after: The preference is partly an availability effect: the near-visible life crowds out value that must be carried by recitation, trace, and reminder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's practiced nearby track gains a contextually supplied friction profile. One ease is the familiar path of immediate life; another ease is deliberately opened toward al-yusra, so ease itself does not settle which path is sound.

activation_trace.role: Following an existing trace supplies a preformed route.
Practice-based skill supplies the route's learned fluency.
Nearness makes the worldly route low-cost to enter.
Opening and ease after difficulty supplies a competing facilitated route.
Lightness and compliant movement supply the felt fluency of that alternative.

structural_cues: 87:8 addresses a singular recipient being eased, whereas 87:16 shifts to a plural group repeatedly preferring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a practiced trace, nearness, and an opened easy path. Reader arrow: both alternatives can feel fluent, but one ease is habituated and the other facilitated. Live alternative: the two ease profiles need not be contrasted.

changed_reading.before: Habit merely repeats preference for what is near.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes a contest between two kinds of ease: inherited worldly fluency and an opened route that can retrain it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selecting the near object is paired with moving the reminder to the side. Preference therefore has two coordinated vectors, approach toward accessible life and active distancing from the disruptive alternative.

activation_trace.role: Preference supplies the approach vector toward one selected object.
Nearness supplies the spatially favored destination.
Putting something at a distance or to the side supplies the avoidance vector.
Hardship and suffering supply the aversive identity attached to that avoidance.
Wretchedness as the opposite of felicity supplies the resulting condition.

structural_cues: The feminine object pronoun in 87:11 points back toward the reminder, while the focus later names the approached object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: nearness, preference, sideward distancing, hardship, and wretchedness. Reader arrow: approach and avoidance are one coordinated selection mechanism. Live alternative: avoidance may characterize only a subgroup, not every plural addressee in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life attracts the subjects by itself.
changed_reading.after: Worldly life becomes dominant through both attraction to nearness and active removal of the reminder from the decision field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context breaks the simple life-death binary by presenting a fire-state that is neither death nor life. Choosing near life can therefore culminate not in another kind of vitality but in deprivation of life as benefit.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit and saving good supplies the qualitative meaning put at risk.
The nearer life supplies the initially favored horizon.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the enclosing consequence-state.
Kindled fire supplies the material force of that state.
Loss of strength and life supplies one explicitly negated endpoint.
Life as benefit supplies the other explicitly negated endpoint, yielding anti-life rather than mere survival.

structural_cues: 87:13 symmetrically negates dying and living after the fire clause of 87:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: fire, negated death, negated life, and life as benefit. Reader arrow: the focus choice is evaluated by the quality of its terminal state, not by biological continuation alone. Live alternative: the consequence may be read only as a later punishment description.

changed_reading.before: The subjects choose one life instead of another.
changed_reading.after: They choose the immediately vivid form of life in a sequence that can end by stripping life of benefit without granting death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Success, purification, mentioning the Name, and worship form an enacted sequence immediately before bal. The focus introduces a rival enacted sequence whose first operation is assigning priority to near life.

activation_trace.role: Putting something first supplies the first operation of the rival sequence.
Preference supplies the choice that enacts rather than merely states the hierarchy.
Attaining success and continuance supplies the outcome of the preceding sequence.
Purity and rectitude supply its first self-directed practice.
Mention on the tongue supplies the sequence's voiced act.
The name as proclamation and signification supplies what the voiced act makes present.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply the relation acknowledged by the Name.
The specific act of worship supplies the sequence's embodied completion.

structural_cues: 87:14-15 gives a verb sequence ending in fa-salla, and 87:16 begins immediately with corrective bal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an ordered success-practice sequence followed by bal and a priority verb. Reader arrow: bal switches from one enacted hierarchy to its rival. Live alternative: bal may issue a broad rebuke without making the two clauses procedural alternatives.

changed_reading.before: Preference is a private attitude interrupting worship.
changed_reading.after: Preference is itself a counter-practice that enacts a rival hierarchy after purification, naming, and worship have enacted another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent comparison decomposes choice into horizon, value, and durability. Immediate appropriation discounts delayed good and consumes what a longer horizon would preserve as a lasting reserve.

activation_trace.role: Putting first supplies explicit priority assignment.
Taking exclusively for oneself supplies immediate appropriation.
Nearness supplies the short decision horizon.
Life as benefit supplies the payoff being compared.
Deferral to a later time supplies the longer horizon.
Seeking good through choice makes the comparison an evaluative selection problem.
Continuance and remaining supply durability.
Holding part back and storing it supplies the reserve model opposed to immediate taking.

structural_cues: 87:17 immediately follows the focus with a coordinated comparative, better and more lasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: near versus delayed, choosing good, durability, storage, and exclusive taking. Reader arrow: these become a temporal-discount mechanism with consumption versus reserve. Live alternative: the verse may make a direct qualitative comparison without an economic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The subjects irrationally prefer this life despite the next being better.
changed_reading.after: They apply a short horizon that overprices accessible benefit, while the next line values a delayed good precisely by its capacity to remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verb joins priority and transmitted trace, while the closing lines locate the comparison in first written records. An older transmission thus carries a future-oriented ranking that corrects the present act of putting nearness first.

activation_trace.role: Putting something first supplies present evaluative precedence.
Transmitting a report until it is handed down supplies inherited continuity.
A written sheet supplies the durable medium of transmission.
The repeated written-sheet image reinforces transmission across named predecessors.
Beginning and precedence supply the antiquity of the corrective ranking.
Return to an outcome supplies the future end already encoded in an earlier record.
The split-map image of priority and entitlement makes firstness echo a claim to rightful precedence.

structural_cues: 87:18 uses the deictic hadha for material placed in the first sheets, and 87:19 repeats sheets with named predecessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: written transmission, beginning, outcome, priority, and the focus root's own transmission branch. Reader arrow: hadha carries the preceding value order into inherited records, so old chronology corrects present priority. Live alternative: the closing claim may attest antiquity without activating the focus verb's trace sense.

changed_reading.before: A present audience makes a locally mistaken comparison.
changed_reading.after: Its present priority is challenged by an older transmitted priority whose first records already direct attention to the later outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the focus root's hoof-marking branch with split mappings of name to visible mark and with overt-hidden cues. It remains anchored in word 2 as trace-following and word 4 as nearness; downstream prose should present it as a semiotic analogy, not as the lexical gloss of tu'thiruna.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 2 and 4 can jointly evoke tracking the nearest legible mark, while life at word 3 is the terrain whose signs are being read.

activation_trace.role: Marking a hoof so its track can be followed supplies a concrete sign-following mechanism.
A remaining sign pointing to what was lets a visible mark stand for an absent source.
Nearness biases the tracker toward the first legible mark.
A visible mark that makes a thing known supplies a split-map sign parallel to the focus trace.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward a thing supplies the navigational function of signs.
Plain ocular appearance supplies the tempting visible channel.
Hiddenness supplies the destination that cannot be inferred from immediate visibility alone.

changed_reading.before: The subjects knowingly choose the inferior object.
changed_reading.after: The subjects may be trackers who mistake the nearest visible mark of life for the destination to which the whole sign system points.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the focus root to stirring and eruption. The reading remains anchored in the supplied word-2 mapped inventory, life-growth at word 3, and nearness at word 4; downstream prose should call it a split-map resonance in which salience acts on the chooser, not a morphological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-2 split inventory permits preference to resonate with something stirred from rest, while near life names what becomes salient.

activation_trace.role: A thing bursting up and spreading outward supplies sudden visible salience.
Stirring something from its settled state supplies the activation event that recruits attention.
Rain-driven growth supplies a life process capable of visible eruption.
Nearness makes the stirred event perceptually dominant.
Scum rising and being carried on water supplies a context image of unstable surface salience.
Dark coloration supplies the visible state that remains after the stirring cycle.

changed_reading.before: A stable subject freely assigns preference to a stable worldly object.
changed_reading.after: Near life may recruit preference by erupting into the perceptual foreground, so salience stirs the chooser before the chooser ranks it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from exclusive possession into plowing, growth, and storage. It remains anchored in the focus branches of appropriation, vegetative life, and nearness, with explicit context images for cultivation; downstream prose should mark it as a material-economic analogy rather than an asserted causal exegesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can construe near life as currently accessible growth seized for oneself rather than a process cultivated beyond the present yield.

activation_trace.role: Exclusive taking for oneself supplies appropriation of the current yield.
Earth brought alive by rain and growth supplies the productive field.
Nearness supplies the temptation to take the present yield.
The farmer splitting the earth supplies labor that opens a future yield.
Growth and increase supply the cultivated process rather than the seized product.
Holding something back and storing it supplies preservation beyond immediate consumption.

changed_reading.before: The subjects choose worldly benefit over later benefit.
changed_reading.after: The subjects seize the nearest yield as private product instead of inhabiting life as cultivation, increase, and preserved remainder.

strongest_changes: Preference became an ordering operation that reverses highest and nearest-lower rather than a bare feeling.
The pasture sequence turned worldly life into a moving growth-to-residue cycle whose nearest visible phase is overvalued.
Recitation, reminder, overt-hidden knowledge, and inherited sheets recast preference as a contest over memory and perceptual availability.
The adjacent better-and-lasting comparison exposed temporal discounting, immediate appropriation, and preserved reserve.
The bal transition after purification, naming, and worship made preference a rival enacted priority sequence.
summary.what_was_special: The split and many-branched focus root allowed preference to coexist with putting first, exclusive taking, transmitted trace, practiced following, visible marks, and even non-dominant stirring. Context then supplied measuring, growth, memory, ritual action, durability, and inherited writing, so several causal readings remained live without collapsing into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The tracking, cultivation, and stirring models depend on branch-level material analogy rather than the ordinary morphology of the focus verb.
The packet supplies contrasts and sequences, but some directional arrows from salience to choice or from choice to terminal state remain reader inferences.
The plural addressees' precise social identity and whether every context subgroup is included are not determined by the sealed packet.
The scope of hadha in 87:18 controls how strongly the written-transmission model attaches to the focus comparison.
